symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of positions on axis $i$, a positive integer.
symbols.quote: For axis $i$, let $\lambda_i$ be the number of positions on that axis.

symbols.name: total length
symbols.meaning: The total number of positions, the product of the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Let $\Lambda=\lambda_1\lambda_2\cdots\lambda_D$ be the total number of positions, which is the length of the one-dimensional cyclic convolution being replaced.

symbols.name: axis indeterminate
symbols.meaning: The indeterminate of axis $i$, whose powers index positions on that axis.
symbols.quote: The target is the multidimensional ring $\mathbb{C}[x_1,\dots,x_D]/(x_1^{\lambda_1}-1,\dots,x_D^{\lambda_D}-1)$, where $x_i$ is the indeterminate of axis $i$.

symbols.name: axis exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of $x_i$ in a monomial of the target.
symbols.quote: Its monomials $x_1^{\eta_1}\cdots x_D^{\eta_D}$ with $0\le\eta_i<\lambda_i$ form a basis, and there are $\Lambda$ of them, since each exponent $\eta_i$ is chosen independently from $\lambda_i$ values.

symbols.name: prefix product
symbols.meaning: The product of the lengths of the axes before axis $i$, with $\sigma_1=1$.
symbols.quote: For each axis $i$, let $\sigma_i=\lambda_1\lambda_2\cdots\lambda_{i-1}$ be the product of the lengths of the axes before it, with $\sigma_1=1$ as an empty product.

symbols.name: inverse modulo axis length
symbols.quote: Let $\mu_i$ be an inverse of $\sigma_i$ modulo $\lambda_i$, so that $\mu_i\sigma_i\equiv 1 \pmod{\lambda_i}$.

symbols.name: coefficient map
symbols.meaning: The map from the one-dimensional ring to the multidimensional target, sending $x$ to $\prod_i x_i^{\mu_i}$.
symbols.quote: Define $\Phi$ on the generator by $\Phi(x) = \prod_{i=1}^D x_i^{\mu_i}$, and it is extended to polynomials as a [ring homomorphism](ring-homomorphism.md).

symbols.name: power exponent
symbols.quote: Let $\nu\ge 0$ be an integer exponent of $\Phi(x)$.

symbols.name: coefficient index
symbols.meaning: An ordinary coefficient index, an integer with $0\le e<\Lambda$.
symbols.quote: Let $e$ be an ordinary coefficient index, with $0\le e<\Lambda$.

symbols.name: mixed-radix digit
symbols.meaning: The digit of $e$ on axis $j$, with $0\le\beta_j<\lambda_j$.
symbols.quote: Its [mixed-radix digits](mixed-radix-digits.md) are $\beta_1,\dots,\beta_D$, where $\beta_j$ is the digit of $e$ on axis $j$ and $0\le\beta_j<\lambda_j$.

symbols.name: axis coordinate
symbols.meaning: The coordinate of the index $e$ on axis $i$, an integer in $[0,\lambda_i)$.
symbols.quote: Let $\gamma_i\in[0,\lambda_i)$ be the exponent of $x_i$ in $\Phi(x^e)$ reduced modulo $\lambda_i$, the coordinate of $e$ on axis $i$.

relations.quote: The Chinese-remainder map is applied to a cyclic convolution of length $\Lambda$ and turns it into a multidimensional one: the product of two coefficient polynomials maps to the product of their images, which is a multidimensional cyclic convolution on the axes $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_D$.
It is the step of the [exact multiplication algorithm](main-theorem.md) that places the coefficients of a [radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md) on distinct prime cyclic axes.
The map then computes its coordinates from the mixed-radix digits of $e$.
